title: Alma Center Servizi Medicali S.r.l.
description: Alma Center is a private multi-specialty diagnostic and outpatient medical center based in Mariglianella (province of Naples, Campania, Italy). Founded in 1984 by Dr. Emanuele Aliperti, it operates as a polispecialistico facility providing a broad range of diagnostic imaging, laboratory, and specialist services under both private and SSN (National Health Service) agreements. https://www.almacenter.it/
